name: NACOSE Business Day Calendar
author: hajimebaba

sections.description:
NACOSE Business Day Calendar shows a monthly calendar of the days your business is open and closed.

  • Japanese public holidays are built in. Fixed holidays, “Happy Monday” holidays, the equinoxes, substitute holidays and Citizens’ Holidays are calculated by the plugin for 2000-2099. No external service or API is used.
  • Regular closing days by rule. Choose weekdays (every Sunday) and “Nth weekday” days (2nd Monday, last Friday) from a simple table. Decide whether public holidays are closing days.
  • Rules that change over time. If your closing days change from a certain date, add a new rule with its start date. Past months keep showing the old rule.
  • Temporary closings and special openings. Register a whole period at once (summer break, inventory days), optionally repeating every year (New Year break). A special opening overrides regular closing days and public holidays.
  • Public holiday adjustments. Remove a holiday or add your own on the settings page, for example after a change of the law, without touching code.
  • Business hours. Set default hours and different hours for single weekdays, and show them together with your regular closing days.
  • Easy to show. Add [business_day_calendar] to any page, post or widget. Colors and legend text can be changed.
  • Accessible. Closed days also carry text for screen readers, not only color.

Shortcode

  • [business_day_calendar] – this month, with previous / next month links
  • [business_day_calendar months="3"] – several months
  • [business_day_calendar month="2027-01"] – a fixed month
  • [business_day_calendar nav="no" legend="no"] – hide the month links and the legend

  • [business_day_today] – a line such as “Today (10/21 Wed) is a business day.” It stays correct on pages kept by a page cache, because a small script picks today’s entry in the site time zone.

  • [business_hours] – business hours and regular closing days, for example “Mon-Fri: 9:30 – 18:30” and “Sunday, 2nd Monday, Public holidays”. Use closed="no" to hide the closing days.

For developers

The filter bdcjp_holidays lets you add, remove or rename public holidays for a year (for example after a change of the law). It receives an array of 'Y-m-d' => 'name' and the year.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nacose-business-day-calendar folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Settings > NACOSE Business Day Calendar and set your regular closing days.
  4. Put [business_day_calendar] in a page.
sections.faq:
Which years are supported?

Public holidays are calculated for 2000-2099.

Does it send data to other sites?

No. Holidays are calculated inside the plugin, and the plugin makes no external requests.

The “today” mark in the monthly calendar is not on today’s date.

If a page cache plugin is used, the cached page can show yesterday’s mark until the cache is refreshed. The closing days themselves are not affected. The [business_day_today] line is not affected, because it is updated in the browser.

The law changed and a holiday is wrong.

Use the bdcjp_holidays filter to correct it, and please report it in the support forum.

0.4.0

  • Renamed to NACOSE Business Day Calendar.

0.3.1

  • Load the bundled Japanese translation explicitly, so the settings page and the calendar are shown in Japanese on every site.

0.3.0

  • Added public holiday adjustments (add or remove a holiday) to the settings page.
  • Added business hours, the [business_hours] shortcode, and hours in the [business_day_today] text.
